name: Solar Array
description: One-time power buffer; ongoing +6 power per level each day.

name: Hydroponics
description: Food stockpile on build; grow lights cost 1 power per level each day.

name: Habitat
description: Population cap on build; +1 morale per level each day from livable quarters.

name: Workshop
description: Morale and credits on build; +3 credits per level each day from fabrication.

name: Radio Tower
description: Trade contacts on build; +2 credits and +1 morale per level from signal upkeep.
